sloka: मा च तम् प्यूढबाह्वम्सम् चन्द्रार्कसम्तेजनम् ।द्राक्षीद्राज्यस्थमासीनम् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२९॥
transliteration: mā ca tam pyūḍhabāhvamsam candrārkasamtejanam ।drākṣīdrājyasthamāsīnam yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-29॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be highly unfortunate like me in not being able to behold that longarmed and broadshoulderd one seated on the throne and resembling both the Sun and the Moon in radiance
